name: Shellet
lore: The first of the clutch to reach the water, and the only one. It has been careful ever since.

source.prompt: Small fantasy sea turtle hatchling with a domed dark green shell patterned with pale hexagons, small flippers, large dark eyes, and sand on its shell, calm serious expression, clean deliberate creature design, no cartoon grin.

die.source_name: custom-Death - The shell cracks apart and the turtle melt

attack.source_name: custom-Lunge Attack - Throws its whole body forward in on + custom-Shell Slam - The hatchling launches off the ground

custom_walk_loop_full_walk_cycle_in.source_name: custom-walk loop, full walk cycle in
